title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: B is a k-linear Karoubian (idempotent-complete) additive category. B_* denotes simplicial objects in B, B_• chain complexes in B, and ND the normalized-chain (Dold–Kan, or Dold–Puppe) functor. 𝔏_* is a cosimplicial free k-module. Neighbouring material and a rank count suggest 𝔏_n ≅ k^{n+1}, plausibly the affine-linear functions t_0,…,t_n on the standard simplex Δ^n.

Λ̇𝔏_* is the cosimplicial graded module Λ^•𝔏_* with a degree −1 differential. This is most plausibly the Koszul contraction with the augmentation t_j ↦ 1. With that differential, Λ^i(k^{n+1}) has a basis of i-subsets of [n], i.e. the (i−1)-simplices of Δ^n. Λ̇𝔏_n is then the augmented simplicial chain complex of Δ^n, shifted by one.

Hom_{k,*}(M^*, L_*) (defined in props. 3 and 5) is the end pairing a cosimplicial k-module with a simplicial object of B.

Prop. 6 claims: ND_i(L_*) ≅ Hom_{k,*}(Λ^i𝔏_*, L_*), and the boundary of ND(L_*) is induced by the differential of Λ̇𝔏_*. In other words, normalization is the weighted limit with weight the cosimplicial chain complex Λ̇𝔏_*.

Proof sketch:
- Put L_• = ND(L_*) and 𝔏(i)_• = ND(Λ^i𝔏_*).
- The Dold–Puppe compatibility of Hom with normalization gives Hom_{k,*}(Λ^i𝔏_*, L_*) ≅ Hom_{k_•}(𝔏(i)_•, L_•).
- By prop. 4, 𝔏(i)_• = C^{i−1}_• for i ≥ 1. This is the 'disk' complex k = k in degrees i−1 and i, and the rank count C(n+1,i) = C(n,i−1)+C(n,i) is consistent with it. Also 𝔏(0)_• = k[0].
- A map from the disk is exactly an element of L_i, so Hom(C^{i−1}, L) ≅ L_i and Hom(k[0], L) ≅ L_0.
- Compatibility of differentials is left as 'petites vérifications'.

Corollary (dual statement, obtained by applying Prop. 6 to B^op): for cosimplicial L^*, ND^•(L^*) ≅ Λ̇𝔏_* ⊗_{k,*} L^*. Since B need not have tensors with k-modules, M_* ⊗ L^* is defined as an object of Hom(B, Ab), namely b ↦ Hom_{Ab_{k_*}}(M_*, Hom_B(L^*, b)). Here 'Ab' is Grothendieck's notation for the category of abelian groups (k-modules). This is a weighted colimit taken in the Yoneda completion; it is representable here.

Purpose: an explicit, coordinate-like description of normalization by the cosimplicial exterior algebra of linear forms on simplices. This feeds the construction of a divided-power de Rham complex attached to (co)simplicial objects, the subject of the 1976 IHÉS lecture.
errors: Off-by-one bookkeeping is delicate: the proof uses 𝔏(i) = ND(Λ^i𝔏) = C^{i−1} (degrees i−1 and i), which is consistent only if 𝔏_n has rank n+1. The page does not fix this or the sign conventions.
The compatibility of the boundary maps with the Koszul/de Rham differential on Λ̇𝔏 is explicitly left unchecked ('il reste à faire de petites vérifications de compatibilité').
The corollary needs the end/coend to be representable in B, or else it is meant in the Yoneda completion. The page states the latter but does not discuss representability.

ideas.what: Normalized complex of a simplicial object expressed as an end against a cosimplicial chain complex (exterior algebra on linear forms of simplices with Koszul-type differential)
ideas.modern_name: Dold–Kan correspondence via weighted (co)limits; N(L) as end/coend against the cosimplicial chain complex N(kΔ^•)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Dold, Kan, Dold–Puppe (1958–61); weighted-limit formulation folklore (e.g. Lurie's Higher Algebra)
ideas.where_published: Possibly echoed in Pursuing Stacks discussions of Dold–Kan; not known to be in print in this form

ideas.what: Identification of the cosimplicial module Λ^i𝔏_* (forms/linear functions on Δ^n) whose normalization is the disk complex C^{i−1}
ideas.modern_name: Cosimplicial Koszul complex / constant-coefficient forms on simplices (cf. Whitney forms, Sullivan polynomial forms)

ideas.what: Dual statement for cosimplicial objects in an arbitrary Karoubian k-linear category, using the tensor defined in the Yoneda completion Hom(B, Ab)
ideas.modern_name: Weighted colimit / tensoring in the presheaf completion

missed.claim: The normalization functor is presented as 'Hom from the cosimplicial exterior algebra of affine-linear forms on Δ^n'. This links Dold–Kan directly to a cosimplicial de Rham/Koszul object, a link later exploited mostly in rational homotopy (Sullivan, Whitney forms) rather than in the divided-power/crystalline setting. It is mildly interesting as context for Grothendieck's divided-power de Rham program, but the statement itself is a known reformulation.
missed.quote: ND_i(L_*) ≃ Hom_{k,*}(Λ̇𝔏_*, L_*) ... l'opérateur diff. sur ND(L_*) provenant de l'op. différentiel sur Λ̇𝔏_*
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Minor: a cosimplicial-forms model of Dold–Kan valid in any Karoubian k-linear category, relevant to divided-power and derived de Rham constructions (Illusie, Bhatt). Not new in substance.

deep.surprise_reason: A clean but standard reformulation of Dold–Kan normalization as a weighted limit against a cosimplicial exterior-algebra complex, with routine proof via prop. 4. Historically it shows Grothendieck's de Rham-with-divided-powers setup, but no unknown result.
transcription_corrections: First line likely reads 'Soit B une catégorie k-linéaire karoubienne' (k-linéaire seems present before karoubienne).
'B^*_*' should be read as the category B_* of simplicial objects of B.
The underbraced labels are 𝔏^i_• and 𝔏_• respectively (normalizations of Λ^i𝔏 and Λ̇𝔏), not extra terms in the formula.
'l'op. différentiel sur T. d [?] sur Λ̇𝔏_*' is probably 'l'op. différentiel sur Λ̇𝔏_*' with an illegible abbreviation; the 'T.' is uncertain.
'Ab_𝒰' in the corollary is the category of 𝒰-small abelian groups (universe 𝒰).
Margin note: 'Feuille volante paumée ...' (stray, mislaid sheet).
